notes:
### New Features

- Separate Player Test tab in Adult TV Test settings, with fixed Penthouse Player and Brazzers Player groups. Only the selected group is checked.
- IPTV-only 90-second Player Test for each matching COM channel present in the saved playlist and Kodi PVR channel map. No website playback or automatic player discovery.
- Enhanced per-channel health classification: completed, completed_with_stalls, start_failed, playback_lost and not_in_pvr.

### Improvements

- Mutually exclusive modes: switching on Player Test disables both 2 h Site/IPTV checks; enabling either 2 h check disables Player Test.
- Track player-time progress, timeline resets, cache drops and bounded Kodi audio/video warning counts to distinguish an ordinary 90-second completion from a potentially stalled playback session.
- Reuse existing PVR channel IDs for direct IPTV playback; skip channels not available in PVR instead of falling back to a website stream.
- Keep the fixed 90-second duration internal and end with Save Log Only, without sleep/shutdown actions.

### Bugfixes

- Remove the unreliable v1.167 player-detection workflow and its obsolete saved fingerprint file.
- Preserve explicit manual channel assignments: KinoXXX TV and Meiden Van Holland TV in Penthouse Player, Babes TV in Brazzers Player. Exclude Dorcel TV and Redlight HD TV from Player Test.
- Avoid the old website HLS precheck blocking an IPTV channel before Kodi can attempt to play it.

### Important

- Player groups are provisional test classifications. A shared player or HLS gateway does not prove the same stream provider or identical buffering behavior.
- The next validation should focus on the Penthouse Player group only. Verify PVR startup, the full 90-second observation, per-channel health labels and Save Log Only. Brazzers Player can be tested later.
- A 90-second test cannot rule out longer periodic source outages; only extend selected representative channels after the quick test is reliable.
- Dorcel's established playback/recovery configuration, native 2 h checks and unrelated website routes remain unchanged. Live LibreELEC validation is still required; v1.167 is the direct rollback.
